Native content was intentionally empty. The correction specifies retaining each raw result under a distinct key, displaying structuredContent, and recovering a display mistake from saved state. A counted one-call replay preserves the full packet and errors; installed skill files resolve to maintained source and11 existing normal-MCP tests pass. This is caller guidance, not enforcement of arbitrary agent-written code or a provider-token experiment.

The schema miss comes from an uppercase-only constant-name extraction filter, then sorted literal candidates and file-start previews. The native-AST exception accepts initialized, error-free simple top-level TypeScript/TSX const identifiers, including exports; existing constant kind/spans/ownership apply. Arrow functions retain their class. Lower-case mutable, destructured, nested, uninitialized or malformed forms gain no new identity. Existing graph semantics and fixed budgets remain. The process-only fallback retains the earlier naming limitation because it cannot prove the needed AST context.

The exact schema query and the retained compound query both select workContextBindingViewSchema locally and read its full637-byte extent1331:1968 on the fixed t21 source hash fcf9ce8fbbefdffcfdbd461a4c5b08e84f7a36220e99aee6dcdd64ad8ce3ca3f. Function input-path, explicit pair, browser and renderer proof controls also pass with exact source spans and complete selected proofs. One actual-host check still selects plan/bootstrap/brain-usage literals and exposes the old tool instructions. Resume W1.8.4.4.9.7 after restart; do not substitute local or alternate-client success for installed-host activation.
